A man on a mat, Mark 2. They broke through a roof to bring him to Jesus, and the Lord, seeing their faith, said first, thy sins be forgiven, then, take up thy bed, and go to thine house. The crowd saw both healing and the Son of man has power on earth to forgive sins. Jesus cares about the whole you—guilt, shame, and body. Come to Him with the whole day, and trust His mercy, not a fake face.
